notes.title: 5.1 update live
notes.content:
Bug fixes

- Few lines of Eric could be heard in certain scenes even when voice acting was disabled, this is now fixed

- Clouds not appearing in Clearmill when playing as Janet has been fixed

- Resolved a nasty bug tied to a resolution where a cutscene did not play if said character was out of focus

Gameplay Tweaks

- Increased Lamia's hit probability to 98%  (was 95%)

- Increased Lamia's mana to 85 (was 50)

- Increased Lamia's evasiveness to 7% (was 5%)

- Increased the Snake's hit probability to 98% (was 95%)

- Increased the chance a Snake's attack can passively poison to 13%  (was 7%)

- Increased Brenda's hit chance to 98%  (was 95%)

notes.title: 5.01 Hotfix
notes.content:
Audio changes

- One line of Janet did not make it to the early release, it has been recorded now.

- Father's lines were missing, they can now be heard in the ending


Bug fixes

- Voice acting couldn't be disabled, it can be disabled properly now

- Had actor's name followed by : in few dialogue options or \nb which were left over code from the earlier version.

- Wrong NPC appearing in Janet's ending fixed
